zh: 技术好的；功夫深的；熟练的
制作精良的；处理巧妙的
en: good at doing something, especially something that needs a particular ability or special training
ex: a skillful player/performer/teacher
熟练的球员/表演者/老师

zh: 撇去（液体上的油脂或乳脂等）
en: to remove fat, cream, etc. from the surface of a liquid
ex: Skim the scum off the jam and let it cool.
撇去果酱上的浮沫，让它冷却。

zh: 攫取（最好的部分）；捞取（精华部分）
en: to take for yourself the best part of something, often in an unfair way
ex: Private companies should not be allowed to skim off profitable sectors of the postal service.
不应允许私人公司略过邮政业中的盈利部门。

en: milk that contains less fat than normal because the cream has been removed from it
a vehicle that can move over snow and ice easily
to try to spend less time, money, etc. on something than is really needed
ex: Older people should not skimp on food or heating.
老人吃饭和取暖不应吝惜。

en: very small and not covering much of your body
ex: a skimpy dress
短而暴露的连衣裙

en: the layer of tissue that covers the body
ex: to have dark/pale skin
皮肤变黑/苍白

zh: 自由潜水（只用简单呼吸设备）
en: the sport or activity of swimming underwater with simple breathing equipment but without a special suit for protection
ex: to go skin diving
去自由潜泳

zh: 植皮；皮肤移植；皮移植片
en: a medical operation in which healthy skin is taken from one part of somebody’s body and placed over another part to replace skin that has been burned or damaged; a piece of skin that is moved in this way
to make a cigarette containing marijuana
not as important or strongly felt as it appears to be

zh: a person who goes skin diving
en: a person who goes skin diving
the use of creams and special products to look after your skin

zh: （涉及他人隐私的）八卦闲聊，闲言碎语
en: conversation about other people's private lives, often including details which may not be true
ex: They talk a lot of skinder.
他们好讲八卦。

en: a person who does not like spending money
a large quantity of alcohol to drink, enough to make you very drunk
ex: I’d had a skinful the night before and was still groggy.
前一天晚上我皮肤很瘦，但仍然很头疼。

zh: 光头仔（尤指暴虐、好斗的青年种族主义者）
en: a young person with very short hair, especially one who is violent, aggressive and racist

zh: 石龙子（蜥蜴，肢体不发达或完全退化）
en: a lizard with short legs or with no legs
used to describe the type of interface (= the way a computer program presents information on the screen) that users can change to suit their particular needs
ex: The program shows a skinnable quick calendar window.
该程序显示了一个可换肤的快速日历窗口。
